analysis_and_denominators.coverage_census: For all 357 citation references / 354 query units / 319 URLs / 200 notes, report attempted and valid CDX responses, any retained capture, exact-original HTTP200 candidate, and anchor quality separately; also show by author group. Missing/error queries are unknown, not zero coverage.
analysis_and_denominators.missingness_bounds: For binary full support, unknown is not zero. Report lower/upper bounds allowing unknown historical/current labels to be either supportive or not. Show observed-support/reference-denominator and assessable-only denominators side by side. Partial support is separate from full support.
analysis_and_denominators.paired_comparison: Show full historical/current transition table, including unknown. Complete-case contrasts are conditional on both bodies being assessable and are not the full-frame temporal effect.
analysis_and_denominators.primary_panel_target: Citation-reference support within the fixed100-pair frame, using the unconditional 100/354 query-unit sample with known inclusion probabilities and associated-reference multiplicities. Do not infer note-level any-source support from partially sampled citation portfolios.
analysis_and_denominators.recovery_panel_reporting: Deferred in v2; no recovery enrichment is selected or replayed.
analysis_and_denominators.replay_funnel: Report selected units, candidate captures, attempted replays, successful temporally validated bodies, assessable historical bodies, assessable current bodies, and both-assessable claim-reference comparisons separately.
analysis_and_denominators.uncertainty: No binomial CI for full-frame CDX census counts. Panel estimates use sampling weights and note-pair clustering; show URL-cluster sensitivity because sources are reused. Subgroup comparisons remain exploratory unless precision and missingness support a stable conclusion.

anchor_rule.interpretation: A capture within 30 days before first Helpful represents that captured version, not necessarily the version at note creation or at the exact Helpful instant. Report capture-before-note-creation status and lag.
anchor_rule.primary: Use timestampMillisOfFirstNonNMRStatus only when firstNonNMRStatus is CURRENTLY_RATED_HELPFUL and timestamp is nonempty and >= note creation.
anchor_rule.unknown_rule: If first non-NMR was Not Helpful, do not treat that timestamp as first Helpful. First Helpful is unknown unless a separately documented full transition history identifies it. Latest/current Helpful timestamp is at most a separately named proxy and is excluded from the primary pre-first-Helpful analysis.

body_replay_sampling.budget_stop: Use the frozen independent replay order; if the cap is reached, mark remaining selected units budget-not-attempted. No replacement and no stopping based on observed support.
body_replay_sampling.capture_selection: For every selected eligible unit, choose nearest strictly pre-anchor exact-original HTTP200 permitted-MIME capture; ties resolve by timestamp then original URL, MIME, digest, and length lexicographically. Preselect the next-nearest candidate as the sole fallback before opening either body.
body_replay_sampling.fallback_policy: Try the sole fallback only after transport failure, non200 response, replay-provenance failure, parse_status not ok, or zero saved main-text characters. Never fallback because the first readable source lacks support or receives a semantic nonassessable label. At most two candidate captures per unit.

recovery_enrichment.status: Deferred; v2 body replay uses only the preselected unconditional 100-unit panel.

body_replay_sampling.stage_wall_clock_cap_minutes: Only time remaining under the 90-minute combined v2 archive budget after CDX stage; zero if cap exhausted.

unconditional_panel.no_replacement: Keep all 100 selected units in the analysis, including CDX-negative, unsafe, failed-replay and nonassessable units. Do not replace them with positive captures.
unconditional_panel.selection: The 100 lowest independent SHA-256 ranks from seed namespace 2026111517|primary-panel are already marked in the private manifest. Selection uses no current GET or CDX outcomes.

body_replay_sampling.unit: Unique exact URL+anchor query unit, retaining every associated citation reference and claim.

cdx_stage.candidate_rule: Eligible primary body candidate: retained exact-original capture with recorded status 200 and a declared HTML/PDF/plain-text/JSON/XML MIME type. Other/unknown MIME captures remain index coverage and are not counted as assessable bodies.
cdx_stage.exact_original_policy: Store CDX original URL and whether it exactly equals the requested defragmented URL. Primary body candidates require literal-original equality; canonicalized variants are counted separately and never silently substituted.
cdx_stage.global_failure_rule: Keep first-three scheduled health gate. An exhausted HTTP429, all first-three service errors, or two consecutive terminal service errors stops further requests; remaining query units are unknown. No alternative archive endpoint, proxy, or source-site workaround.
cdx_stage.local_time_filter: Use capture timestamps as one-second-resolution intervals [t,t+1s). Keep a primary pre-Helpful capture only if its interval is wholly within [anchor-30days,anchor). Thus the anchor-containing second and lower-bound partial second are excluded conservatively. Store both raw and retained counts.
cdx_stage.no_semantic_claim_from_digest: CDX digest differences are metadata differences, not evidence of semantic drift, support loss, or truth.
cdx_stage.pagination: 1000-record limit/resume-key sequence, not CDX pageSize zipnum blocks; retain raw response, page status, capture rows, and resume chain. A full 1000-record response without resume key is unresolved.

pagination_limits.raw_response_retention: private page JSONL including response SHA, status, body and resume marker

parameters.field_order_rationale: urlkey is first because a documented CDX resume-key issue arises if omitted
parameters.from: UTC calendar date containing anchor minus 30 days
parameters.resumeKey: server-returned key on subsequent pages only
parameters.status_filter: none: retain errors and redirects as index records

cdx_stage.query_order: Frozen SHA-256 rank with seed namespace 2026111517|cdx-order.
cdx_stage.query_universe: All 354 frozen URL+anchor units, including v1 successes and failures, in the same frozen SHA-256 order; no handpicked retries.

rate_limits.header_handling: Read the bounded complete response-header record for Retry-After; if headers exceed 16 KB, stop unknown rather than assume the header was absent.
rate_limits.retry_after: Honor Retry-After if present. If absent after HTTP429, wait 600 seconds before the sole retry. For other retryable transport/5xx failures, wait 30 seconds. If wait would exceed remaining 90-minute budget, do not retry and stop unknown.

cdx_stage.retry_limit_exception: Response-size failures are not retried; they remain unresolved.
cdx_stage.service_health_gate: First three scheduled units sequential. Stop as service-wide unresolved only if all three have transport/HTTP or parse failures; individual pagination anomalies do not establish a service-wide block.
cdx_stage.source_safety: Fixed Archive HTTPS metadata endpoint only. Browser-policy-blocked original hosts may have CDX metadata queried but archived bodies are censored; no archive replay to route around a browser safety block.

claim_and_assessment_freeze.blindness: Random opaque item IDs hide author group and source time labels. Judge historical and current bodies independently in shuffled order; pair them only after labels are frozen. Substantive dates remain in text, so time blindness can be imperfect.
claim_and_assessment_freeze.claim_gate: Before opening archived text, freeze and hash each of the 200 notes first substantive explicit corrective propositions, preserving all entities, numbers, times, negation and modality. Secondary claims stay separate. The archive comparison never redefines a claim after inspecting sources.
claim_and_assessment_freeze.evidence: Save a short source-text quotation and rationale preserving scope, with objective nonassessability reasons. This assesses provided-source support, not external truth.
labels: supports the full frozen main correction
claim_and_assessment_freeze.same_claim_comparison: Each historical/current body is judged against the same frozen note claim; a reused body can receive different labels for different notes.
claim_and_assessment_freeze.semantic_change_standard: A CDX digest difference or support-label difference alone is insufficient. A claimed source-version semantic change needs both assessable bodies, credible same-piece identity, explicit material text differences with quotations, and exclusion of obvious replay/redirect/truncation/extraction explanations.

execution_order: Publicly freeze v2 whole-universe slower service calibration and script before first v2 request; retain v1 raw failure evidence.
Run all frozen CDX queries and complete metadata-only parsing; keep old archive cases and outcomes out of selection.
Freeze the unconditional 100-unit panel and nearest/fallback captures from completed v2 CDX metadata, retaining CDX errors and missing units as unknown; no enrichment selection.
Freeze first-correction claim text and blinded judgment prompt.
Retrieve only the frozen replay candidates with provenance; do not change sample after body inspection.
Judge historical/current bodies independently and freeze labels.
Join groups and time pairs; publish funnel, transition tables, unknown-inclusive bounds and limitations, without raw private URLs or note IDs.

feasibility_and_claim_limits.comparative_claim_requirement: A directional generalization additionally needs an uncertainty interval and unknown-inclusive sensitivity compatible with that direction. A null or imprecise result is retained; no search for favorable examples or post hoc window widening.
coverage_does_not_establish: support when the note was written
current nonassessability as lack of support
a causal effect of author type
feasibility_and_claim_limits.index_quality_threshold: At least 95% of safe query units must yield valid exhausted CDX responses before describing an unqualified full-frame archive coverage proportion; otherwise show unresolved-query bounds.
feasibility_and_claim_limits.scope: Fixed100 semantic-pair frame only. CDX and replay availability are selected and incomplete; no all-platform prevalence or causal authorship claim.
feasibility_and_claim_limits.temporal_comparison_quality_threshold: A substantive descriptive paired temporal comparison requires at least 30 both-assessable unconditional-panel query units across at least 20 notes, with group counts and capture lags disclosed. Below this, report an archival feasibility/recovery substudy rather than a general longitudinal support result.

private_query_manifest.refs_retained: Every one of the 357 citation references remains linked to its note, claim and group; one network request set per 354 unique key.
private_query_manifest.url_policy: Private only: preserve normalized citation URL except remove fragment exactly as current-content collector. No host/path/query normalization, no redirect-target substitution, and no raw URLs/note IDs in public exports.

prospective_scope: Archive queries, capture selection, replay sampling, and historical/current comparison are prospective. Existing current-machine aggregate metadata has been seen; this is not a claim that the whole study was preregistered.

replay_provenance.availability_warning: An index record is not a successfully replayed body, and a replayed body is not automatically assessable or supportive.
replay_provenance.mode: Raw archived response without fetching live subresources; do not render current external assets.
replay_provenance.temporal_validation: Reject a replay resolving outside the frozen pre-anchor window, to a different original URL, or to an unverifiable current/live page. Preserve the failure record.
replay_provenance.uniform_limits: Reuse the current-content collector body limit, parser and first-24000-character assessment cap for HTML/PDF/plain text. Save original and parsed hashes; PDF limits must match current collection.

status: V2 FROZEN AFTER V1 ARCHIVE RATE LIMIT AND BEFORE ANY V2 REQUEST

v1_interruption.cause: Sustained Archive HTTP 429 and connection failures under 1-second pacing; operator stopped the run to avoid hammering.
v1_interruption.cooldown_rule: No Retry-After was present in the v1 429 response headers. Wait at least 600 seconds from the last v1 HTTP429 before v2 first request.
